zh.app.name: 白话智能体
zh.app.title.board: 审稿台 · 白话智能体
zh.lang.label: 语言
zh.front.hero.title: 把一篇论文，写成公众读得懂的稿子。
zh.front.hero.lead: 读论文，抽出一份「依据清单」，为不同平台起草，再用另一个模型逐句核对。任何超出依据的说法都会标出来交给你处理。
zh.front.hero.note: 稿子永远不会自动发布。
zh.front.demo.caption: 依据清单里有什么，稿子里才能写什么
zh.front.demo.claim: 在12只小鼠中，肿瘤体积平均缩小了23%
zh.front.demo.meta: high · 小鼠, n=12, 初步
zh.front.demo.writtenText: 在12只小鼠中（初步结果），肿瘤体积平均缩小了23%
zh.front.demo.why: 丢掉了物种、样本量与「初步」——依据清单撑不起这句话。
zh.front.rules.head: 不会妥协的四条
zh.front.rules.1.title: 写得出，就查得到
zh.front.rules.1.body: 数字、因果、程度、「首次」、「证明」——任何一句这样的话都必须对应依据清单里的一条，否则不写。
zh.front.rules.2.title: 限定词跟着走
zh.front.rules.2.body: 物种、样本量、「初步」、相关不等于因果——起草时保留，核对时检查。
zh.front.rules.3.title: 不自己给自己打分
zh.front.rules.3.body: 起草与核对用不同的模型、不同的提示词。两者设成同一个模型时，审稿台拒绝开工。
zh.front.rules.4.title: 永不自动发布
zh.front.rules.4.body: 产出的是草稿、出处和存疑标记，交给人审。发布这一步永远由人来做。
zh.front.pipeline.head: 一次运行经过什么
zh.front.pipeline.1.title: 取全文
zh.front.pipeline.1.body: 链接、DOI 或 PDF。摘要页会自动升级成全文 PDF；取不到就说清楚为什么，并请你补一个 PDF。
zh.front.pipeline.2.title: 建依据清单
zh.front.pipeline.2.body: 把论文里可引用的结论逐条抽出来，每条带上原文依据、限定词和置信度。清单是空的，就什么都不写。
zh.front.pipeline.3.title: 分平台起草
zh.front.pipeline.3.body: 新闻稿与小红书各有结构；语言、读者、活泼度是参数。每个事实句都标注它引用的依据编号。
zh.front.pipeline.4.title: 逐句核对
zh.front.pipeline.4.body: 换一个更强的模型，只对着依据清单读稿子，标出相关当因果、丢限定词、以偏概全、清单里没有的说法。
zh.front.pipeline.aside: 两条支线只影响文风、不提供事实：外部背景检索给起草提供叙事语境，`api/styles/examples/` 里的范文会被蒸馏成语气画像。核对模型两者都看不到。
zh.front.tools.head: MCP 工具
zh.front.tools.aside: 下面这份清单直接读自 `agent.yaml`，与平台看到的契约是同一份。
zh.front.roles.head: 模型分工
zh.front.roles.aside: 按角色声明，具体模型名写在配置里，代码里从不写死。

en.app.name: ScicomAgent
en.lang.label: Language
en.front.hero.title: Turn a paper into something the public can actually read.
en.front.hero.lead: It reads the paper, extracts a claim ledger, drafts for each platform, then audits every sentence against that ledger with a different model. Anything that outruns its source is flagged for you.
en.front.demo.caption: What the ledger holds is what the draft may say
en.front.demo.claim: Tumour volume fell 23% on average in 12 mice
en.front.demo.writtenText: In 12 mice, tumour volume fell 23% on average (preliminary)
en.front.demo.why: Drops the species, the sample size and “preliminary” — the ledger cannot hold this sentence up.
en.front.rules.head: The rules it will not bend
en.front.rules.1.title: Written means sourced
en.front.rules.1.body: Every number, causal claim, magnitude, “first” or “proves” maps to a ledger entry, or it is not written.
en.front.rules.2.title: Qualifiers travel with the claim
en.front.rules.2.body: Species, sample size, “preliminary”, correlation-not-causation: carried into the prose, then checked.
en.front.rules.3.title: No grading your own work
en.front.rules.3.body: Drafting and checking use different models and different prompts. Set them the same and the board refuses to start.
en.front.rules.4.title: Never auto-published
en.front.rules.4.body: The output is a draft, its provenance and its flags — for a human. Publishing is never automated.
en.front.pipeline.head: What one run does
en.front.pipeline.1.title: Fetch the full text
en.front.pipeline.1.body: A link, a DOI or a PDF. Abstract pages are upgraded to the full-text PDF; when that fails it says why and asks you for the PDF.
en.front.pipeline.2.title: Build the claim ledger
en.front.pipeline.2.body: Every citable finding, with its source evidence, its qualifier and a confidence. An empty ledger means nothing gets written.
en.front.pipeline.3.title: Draft per platform
en.front.pipeline.3.body: News and Xiaohongshu have their own structure; language, audience and liveliness are parameters. Every factual sentence cites the entry it rests on.
en.front.pipeline.4.title: Check it sentence by sentence
en.front.pipeline.4.body: A stronger, different model reads the draft against the ledger alone, flagging correlation-as-causation, dropped qualifiers, minor findings sold as conclusions, and claims that are not there.
en.front.pipeline.aside: Two side paths shape voice but never supply facts: background search gives the drafter narrative context, and the examples in `api/styles/examples/` are distilled into a voice profile. The checker sees neither.
en.front.tools.head: MCP tools
en.front.tools.aside: Read straight from `agent.yaml`, so it is the same contract the platform sees.
en.front.roles.head: Model roles
en.front.roles.aside: Declared by role; concrete names live in config, never in code.

en.rewrite.applied: Applied — it is re-checked when you complete the review
